intended_geographic_scope: Northeast India (Assam, Meghalaya, Sikkim, Nagaland, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Tripura)
prediction_horizon: Instantaneous hazard conditional on 24h and 72h antecedent hydrometeorological stress

thresholds.action_protocol: Routine baseline monitoring. Standard public vigilance.
thresholds.intended_use: Advisory context for general public and field maintenance crews.

thresholds.action_protocol: Advisory inspection of vulnerable cuttings, culverts, and toe drains.
thresholds.intended_use: District disaster management authorities and road maintenance patrols.

thresholds.action_protocol: Heightened surveillance on critical slopes; pre-deployment of heavy equipment.
thresholds.intended_use: Emergency response coordination and localized traffic diversions.

thresholds.action_protocol: Critical geotechnical alert; technical field inspection required.
thresholds.intended_use: Internal technical coordination only. PROHIBITED from triggering automatic sirens or evacuations.

trade_off_analysis.lower_threshold_effect: Increases sensitivity (reduces missed events / false negatives) at the cost of higher false-alarm rate (FAR), which can cause warning fatigue.
trade_off_analysis.higher_threshold_effect: Increases precision (reduces false alarms) but increases risk of missed slope failures (false negatives), potentially compromising life safety.
trade_off_analysis.current_compromise: Provisional cutoffs chosen as conservative engineering demonstration baselines. Must not be deployed operationally without formal ROC/cost-matrix tuning.

required_reviewer_qualifications: Senior Geotechnical Engineer with >= 10 years experience in Himalayan slope stability
Engineering Geologist certified by Geological Survey of India (GSI) or equivalent body
State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA) Technical Advisor
governance_directives: Thresholds are experimental candidate values awaiting formal expert committee review.
Do NOT describe these thresholds as scientifically established or officially endorsed.
Do NOT trigger automatic public alerts or civil-protection evacuation notices from these thresholds.
